edges: The defendant contends that by the time the backpack was searched, the vehicle had been constructively impounded by the police.
The defendant was deprived of his Sixth Amendment right to counsel due to a conflict of interest with appointed counsels.
Both car and contents had been seized.
The defendant asserts that the offenses involved similar conduct and occurred three months apart.
The defendant contends that he was not arrested until after he had taken the actions underlying the charges.
The defendant does not contend that the vehicle was immobile when the stop occurred.
Defendant asserts that the automobile exception was extinguished.
Defendant is the prevailing party and is presumably entitled to an award of costs.
